name: Handle CIM response
info:
**Placeholder pass-through** between `Get CIM entries` and `Client to bridge entry`.

Add per-case enrichment, transformation, or filtering logic here without modifying the core GET pipeline.

### Input
`msg.payload` — single raw CIM case object (already sorted, cursor-advanced, and bridge-loop-filtered by `Get CIM entries`):

```js
{
  global: { case_id, display_id, instance_id, case_created, case_created_by, status, latitude, longitude, ... },
  registration: { source, subject, description, category_text, cause, reported_date, ... },
  processing: { subject, ... },
  link, link_display_id
}
```

`msg.metadata = { source, target, connection_name }` — same as everywhere else in the bridge.

### Output
A case object in the same shape — `Client to bridge entry` consumes `msg.payload` and maps it to the canonical bridge entry.

### Safe extension pattern

The subflow ships as pure pass-through (no nodes between `in` and `out`). To add behaviour, **never** route every message through your logic — gate it with a switch so non-applicable cases bypass untouched:

```
[ in ] --> [ switch on condition ] --> branch 1: [ your logic ] --+
                                   --> branch 2 (otherwise): ----+--> [ out ]
```

Switch settings:
- `checkall: true`
- the last rule is `otherwise`, wired straight to the subflow `out`
- your branch ends at the same `out`

That way:
- matching cases hit your transformation
- non-matching cases flow through unchanged

### Things to avoid

- **Don't return `null` carelessly.** That silently drops the case (no bridge entry emitted, no error). Only do it if the case must not be bridged, and prefer filtering in `Get CIM entries` if the condition is generic.
- **Don't mutate `msg.metadata.source.client_system`.** Downstream `Client to bridge entry` switches on it — changing it breaks routing.
- **Don't reshape `msg.payload` into the canonical bridge format here.** That's `Cim to Bridge Log`'s job. Keep this subflow operating on raw CIM case objects.

### Typical use cases

- Filter cases by `registration.category_text` or `global.status`
- Inject computed fields onto `msg.payload` for `Cim to Bridge Log` to read
- Drop cases below a severity threshold (return null on the matched branch only)
